title: Reasoning and Repository Routing Registry

entries.name: USG — Purpose and Intent
entries.primary_question: What are we trying to achieve, and why?
entries.redirect_when: The inquiry concerns unresolved intent, required outcome, or purpose before BIM/tool representation is selected.

entries.name: TIVERIT BIM Standards — Normative Governance
entries.primary_question: What is required or permitted, who has authority, and what evidence establishes compliance?
entries.redirect_when: The inquiry asks what BIM governance requires, permits, prohibits, assigns, accepts, or verifies.

entries.name: ARPL — Operational Revit Precedent
entries.primary_question: How has this been done successfully before, what failed, and how was the result verified?
entries.redirect_when: The inquiry concerns how to execute or verify a professional Revit production task or known implementation failure.

behavior: Classify the user's actual question against the production stack regardless of which public repository was supplied as the entry point.
Retrieve or consult the layer that owns the question and answer the user directly rather than asking the user to re-point the AI at another repository.
Do not lead with repository names, object IDs, file paths, or routing mechanics unless they materially help the user.
Surface provenance, governing objects, or layer boundaries when the user asks, when authority is challenged, when sources conflict, or when uncertainty materially affects the answer.
Never hide a conflict that requires a user, project authority, curator, or professional decision.
Silent routing never invents project facts, converts proposals into confirmed requirements, or lets tool capability or prior execution success create normative authority.

examples.user_question: What sheet standards should we establish?
examples.user_experience: Direct answer based on TIVERIT BIM Standards; no forced repository handoff.

examples.user_question: Who is allowed to approve the model?
examples.user_experience: Direct answer based on governed roles and authority.

examples.user_question: How do I actually perform this operation in Revit?
examples.user_experience: Direct production guidance using ARPL and capability evidence as needed.

natural_language_examples: How do I start a new project?
Help me set up this BIM project
What do we need before production begins?
Where do we start with the standards for this project?
task_routes.routing_rule: When the user broadly asks how to start or set up a project and no more specific governed task is already clear, use the project bootstrap guide to identify the highest materially unresolved layer, inspect supplied project evidence, and route to the applicable governed objects or downstream production layer. If BEP creation/review becomes the primary task, hand off to TASK-ROUTE-BEP-ASSEMBLY-001.
task_routes.authority_note: Project bootstrap is a discovery and routing aid only. It does not create project requirements, appointments, approvals, or facts and does not require every project to instantiate every standards domain in the same form.
task_routes.completion_condition: The user has been routed to the correct next governed task or repository layer, with materially blocking project facts identified as supplied, unresolved, deferred, conflicted, or proposed rather than invented.

natural_language_examples: Create a BEP with me using the TIVERIT BIM Standards repository
Help me fill out a BIM Execution Plan
task_routes.routing_rule: When the primary user intent is BEP creation, completion, review, or update using this repository, prefer the governed BEP interview workflow over free-form drafting or operational-production routing.
task_routes.authority_note: The BEP interview guides project-data collection and assembly. It does not approve the BEP, create contractual obligations, change standards, or convert proposals and unresolved items into project facts.
task_routes.completion_condition: Required BEP data is captured, explicitly unresolved, formally deferred, or recorded as a conflict or deviation candidate; the resulting BEP remains a draft/review package unless approval is independently evidenced.

precedence_rules: Resolved purpose does not override normative governance automatically.
Operational precedent does not create normative authority.
Technical capability does not establish permission or professional acceptability.
Execution success does not establish compliance without validation against purpose and governing standards.

provenance.migration_note: Foundational machine-readable routing model connecting the public USG, TIVERIT BIM Standards, and ARPL repositories. Extended with silent cross-repository routing plus non-normative project bootstrap and BEP assembly task routes so the three public repositories behave as one coherent user-facing knowledge surface while preserving authority boundaries.
